newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Delta to halt Russia-Germany flights.
newsitem.headline: Delta to halt Russia-Germany flights.

text.p: U.S. Delta Air Lines said on Wednesday that it would halt its regular passenger flights servicing Moscow and St Petersburg from Frankfurt next month.
A company statement from the Moscow office said that service between St Petersburg and Frankfurt via Warsaw would end March 6, while flights between Moscow and Frankfurt would cease on April 7.
Delta would continue to operate daily nonstop flights between Moscow and New York.
"Upcoming changes to Delta's European schedule unfortunately make it impossible for the airline to maintain a viable operation between Frankfurt and the two Russian cities," the statement said.
It also said that "in the St Petersburg market Delta plans to retain a presence by initiating code-share service with one of its global partner airlines in the near future".
